verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents webhooks that notify an integrator's application of account events, and an automatic fiat-to-stablecoin conversion on incoming transfers. Webhooks are developer building blocks: the integrator would have to write the rule logic themselves. The auto-conversion is a fixed product behavior, not a user-defined rule. There is no evidence of a native rules or automation engine where users define event-triggered actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
